description: For remodel scope, this estimate request form records demolition, new work, allowances, selections, exclusions, temporary conditions, sequence, and responsibility boundaries. subtitle: Remodel Scope Estimate Request Form: residential or commercial remodel scope definition using existing spaces, demolition, and existing-condition photos.
title: Remodel Scope Estimate Request Form
use_case: Use the estimate request form during residential or commercial remodel scope definition when the remodel scope record must identify existing spaces, owner objectives, fixtures, finishes, structural interfaces, utilities, access, and occupied operations. Complete the applicable handoff for agreed scope, assumptions and exclusions, budget handoff, design questions, milestone plan, and owner acknowledgment.
